title: Post-review fix cycle for the gateway launch variant (AFK-PORT-1.4-LV)
summary: One bounded fix cycle applying six reviewer-defined items to the gateway launch class in the kit's dispatch adapter: an xtrace guard at the head of the generated command text so an inherited set -x cannot render the credential; hoisting a stale-artifact removal above the fail-closed preflights; a new stubbed-integration test proving an empty credential read ends as a launch failure through orca_launch (never status done); two wording corrections in the contract doc and script header; a corrected risk statement in the story record; and a post-review registry. Small surgical edits to dispatch.sh, run-tests.sh, one doc and the record, each pinned by the reviewer's reproduction scripts; native command text must stay byte-identical.
